text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, Dad. That day works perfectly. I'll 
make sure to put the dinner on my 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh!? A piano lesson on this day!? 
It's usually on a different day of the 
week...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Swimming and flower arrangement are 
here... Wait, calligraphy and English 
conversation are overlapping too...?!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What is this...?! The schedule is a total 
mess...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina is too exhausted, and it's 
starting to disrupt her schedule 
management. It looks like we'll need to 
reconsider her race plans.
